title: Club Membership: reactivation payment basis for a past-due contract
content:
## Scope
This document states the basis on which Club Membership computes what a member must pay to reactivate a membership contract sitting in past due status: the current dues balance plus the tier's own reactivation fee.

## Per-tier reactivation fee
| Tier | Reactivation fee |
|---|---|
| Base Club Access | $25.00 |
| Student Metro Access | $15.00 |
| Off-Peak Metro Access | $25.00 |
| Metro Multi-Club Access | $25.00 |
| Premier All-Access | $25.00 |
| Black Card All-Access | $0.00 |
| Founding Legacy Access | $0.00 |

## Rule
To reactivate a membership contract sitting in past due status, the member must pay the contract's full current dues balance, plus the tier's own reactivation fee shown above. The current dues balance is evaluated at the moment the reactivation payment is processed, so that any late fee charge posted earlier in the same consultation is included in that balance.

## Prerequisite: the current balance must already reflect the late fee for the missed payment
This policy's own basis holds that the current dues balance must reflect any late fee charge already posted for the missed payment before the reactivation payment amount is computed; where that late fee charge is not yet posted, the current dues balance is not yet complete and this reactivation payment is not handled.

## Points of judgement
A late fee charge posted to the contract earlier in the same consultation, before the reactivation payment is computed, is included in the current dues balance the member must pay; a late fee posted only after the reactivation payment has already been computed is not reflected in that already-computed balance.
